summary: V33 — Tenant-scoped stats/overview + plan-feature backend enforcement + Stripe renew — 21/21 pytest PASS. Verified: (1) GET /api/stats/overview returns license-scoped counters — bayi (installed panel license MS-A1B3833C1DD6441FBCF19F26) sees scanned=0/caught=0 while master (x-master-key) sees full DB view. (2) POST /api/blacklist/check|/blacklist/delist|/rules return 403 with Turkish message 'Bu özellik (X) '<plan>' planınızda kapalı — üst versiyona geçin.' when the corresponding plan matrix key is flipped (pro.blacklist_check=false, pro.blacklist_manage=false, pro.custom_rules=false); after reset bayi restored to 200. Master with x-master-key bypasses gates (plan resolves to enterprise which stays true) — validated on blacklist_check and rules. (3) POST /api/subscription/renew {billing_period:'yearly'} → 200 with real Stripe checkout URL (https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...), session_id, renewal:true — no more 503 'Stripe yapılandırılmamış'. Pricing plans intact (starter 29/290, pro 79/790, enterprise 199/1990). Regression clean on 13 endpoints (plugin/status, plan/features, engines, settings, rules, plugin/renewal-info, admin/plan-matrix, plan-matrix/history, bayi-servers, impersonate/status, resellers-live, threat-alerts, plan-funnel, bayi/my-server).

minor.issue: Actual message wraps plan in single quotes: 'Bu özellik (blacklist_check) \'pro\' planınızda kapalı — üst versiyona geçin.' — user-facing spec listed 'pro planınızda' (no quotes). Frontend prompts should match. Cosmetic — test only asserts substring 'kapalı'.

Master bypass is IMPLICIT — master's plan resolves to 'enterprise' via _plan_of_scope, and enterprise plan defaults keep the feature enabled. If a master ever flips enterprise.blacklist_check=false, they will lock themselves out of their own endpoint. Recommend an explicit `if scope['is_master']: return` short-circuit in _require_feature (like rules_add does) to prevent self-lockout.

action_items: (Minor) Add explicit master bypass inside _require_feature (e.g., `if scope.get('is_master') and not scope.get('impersonated'): return`) instead of relying on enterprise plan defaults — prevents accidental master self-lockout.
(Cosmetic) Consider dropping single quotes around plan name in _require_feature message to match user-facing docs, or update docs to match code.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~5767 lines — v32 recommendation to split (plan_matrix, bayi_server, impersonate modules) still not addressed.

_require_feature is called unconditionally on blacklist_check/blacklist_delist — master relies on plan=enterprise having the feature. Should have explicit is_master bypass for defense-in-depth. rules_add already does this correctly (line 1352 `if not scope['is_master']: await _require_feature(...)`).

stats_overview quarantine filter (line 1008) uses `{}` (unfiltered) for master when owner is empty — correct — but engines filter uses `{'owner_license_key': ''}` as master fallback which assumes seed template has empty owner. If any real bayi engine records existed without owner_key they'd leak into master view. Consider explicit index or query on `is_default:true`.

_stripe_client accepts any non-empty STRIPE_API_KEY string — the sk_test_emergent value is a shared sandbox; no validation that key format matches sk_test_/sk_live_. Fine for now but a typo like ' ' would pass strip() checks and fail deeper in Stripe SDK with a less clear error.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — plan matrix modified during tests but reset in module teardown + inline try/finally. Any master-created TEST_rule cleaned via best-effort DELETE.
